gold: Syringocystadenocarcinoma papilliferum in situ (SCACPIS) arising in a precursor lesion of syringocystadenoma papilliferum (SCAP) with macular amyloidosis

selector.rationale: The presence of a circumscribed tumor with apocrine epithelial lining, papillary projections, and positive p63 staining in myoepithelial cell layers supports Hidradenoma papilliferum, which is a type of apocrine gland tumor.

rejected.label: Syringocystadenoma papilliferum
rejected.why: Low score and lack of specific findings

rejected.label: Apocrine gland carcinoma
rejected.why: Although there are atypical cells and mitotic figures, the absence of dermal invasion does not support carcinoma

rejected.label: Amyloidosis
rejected.why: The presence of congophilic amorphous eosinophilic deposits is noted, but it is not a primary feature of the lesion
